_note_manuscript: Downloads/ECE 4-5 TG Level 2 Icibemba submit Doc.docx (saved 7 Nov 2026 by Margaret Nambao, no comments or tracked changes). Sister of the Level 1 TG (ICIBEMBA ECE 3-4 TG): same front matter, labels and look. This sidecar is generated by a script from the ZEPH_BLOCKS dump (setHeading list) plus hand-written keys.
subject: Icibemba
_note_cover: The manuscript's cover picture (image1.png, 1129x1393) is a finished mock-up with ICIBEMBA, the book-type band, the coat of arms and an 'Imyaka 3-4' badge (left from Level 1) baked in. Word-free crop of the teacher and the children only, Real-ESRGAN x4. Nothing painted.
_note_terms: The term markers are one-cell tables: Temu 1, Term 2 (in English) and Temu 3. Term 2 becomes TEMU 2 where the author put it, before Icipande 5.
_note_labels: One look for each recurring label, as the Level 1 TG. Units 9-12 use other words for the same labels (Amashiwi Yacindama, Icishinka ku Kusambilisha ...); they take the label the rest of the book uses.
_note_signatory: Front-matter signatories alike: name bold, title and office plain.
_note_imprint: Copyright page in the house order (Silozi G4 LB model, as the Level 1 TG): bold label above plain value, the manuscript's own Icibemba labels; layout credit the house default. ISBN and editor left blank as on Level 1.

_note_edit: Full read 2026-11-12 (standing rule: fix everything). Cinyanja lines pasted into the Icibemba text rewritten from the same lesson's own Icibemba words (author to confirm); keyboard slips; doubled words; labels merged into the line above split out; one spelling per word by this book's majority (caati, amacaati, amabuuku, ifiunda, kaadi, amakaadi, ifyanguka, pampela, kumpela); the rhyme lesson says impela (ending), not intanshi (beginning); /d/ -> /f/ for 'foloko'; Iciputulwa 1/2 -> Levo 2; Kinyanja -> Icibemba. Summaries headed IBUKISHENI in units 9-11 are Ukusupawila like units 1-8, and the two notes headed UKUSUPAWILA in units 11-12 are IBUKISHENI notes.
